```yaml
name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every 6 hours
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  sync-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout airbyte repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Checkout airbyte-agent-connectors repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors
          path: source-connectors
          token: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}

      - name: Sync connector docs
        run: |
          # Create target directory if it doesn't exist
          mkdir -p docs/ai-agents/connectors

          # Find all connector directories in the source repo
          # Assuming structure: source-connectors/<connector-name>/
          for connector_dir in source-connectors/*/; do
            if [ -d "$connector_dir" ]; then
              connector_name=$(basename "$connector_dir")
              target_dir="docs/ai-agents/connectors/${connector_name}"
              mkdir -p "$target_dir"
              
              # Copy all .md files from the connector folder to the target
              # This includes README.md, REFERENCE.md, CHANGELOG.md, etc.
              cp "$connector_dir"*.md "$target_dir/" 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
          done

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git-check
        run: |
          git status
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "docs: sync AI connector docs from airbyte-agent-connectors"
          title: "docs: sync AI connector docs"
          body: |
            Automated sync of AI connector documentation from `airbytehq/airbyte-agent-connectors`.
            
            This PR was generated by the `sync-ai-connector-docs` workflow.
          branch: "chore/sync-ai-connector-docs"
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            documentation
            auto-merge
          signoff: true
```
